name: Steel MCP Server
summary: MCP server giving Claude, Cursor or any MCP client a real cloud Chrome on Steel: read pages that block fetch, fill forms, screenshot, hand off to a human.
description: Local server (GitHub releases or `npx -y github:steel-dev/steel-mcp-server`; not published to npm) that needs a Steel API key; the free tier is enough to try it. A hosted mcp.steel.dev is not live yet.

agent_access.notes: Set STEEL_API_KEY in the server environment.
